# Cifia Global Journal

> > Open-access academic journal publishing peer-reviewed research in Islamic studies, theology, philosophy, and Quranic scholarship.

Published by CIF Foundation International (CIFF) in Hyderabad, India, Cifia Global Journal (CGJ, ISSN 2582-6859) serves as a platform for scholarly discourse on Islamic research, Sahih Iman, and contemporary Muslim thought. The journal operates under COPE publication ethics standards and welcomes submissions from researchers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Islamic Studies
- Islamic Theology
- Quran and Hadith Research
- Islamic Philosophy
- Sahih Iman
- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review
- Academic Research
- Muslim Scholarship
- CIF Foundation International
- Ash Shaikh Mir Asedullah Quadri
- Publication Ethics
- Islamic Sufism
- Contemporary Islamic Thought
